[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Sector Crescent[/color][/head]
Sector Crescent is a rich, politically unstable frontier where old law, new money, armed labor, religious authority, and private enterprise compete over the same routes and resources.
Its wars continue because Crescent is [bold]useful[/bold], not because it is dead or cut off from civilization. The sector contains valuable stations, established trade routes, extraordinary mineral wealth, and a regional temporal anomaly that can renew exposed resource fields.
Imperial charters, independent feudal ventures, worker settlements, merchant colonies, and corporate concessions developed beside one another. Their laws overlap: a cargo may owe noble tithe, guild dues, docking debt, corporate credit, and revolutionary claims at the same time. Crescent is not lawless. It is crowded with law.
The intended tone is a violent medieval frontier translated into space: charters, noble privilege, burgher finance, religious courts, worker leagues, mercantile rivalry, family oaths, local law, and armed expeditions.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Read on[/color][/head]
